title: Quote: The most compelling reason for most people to buy a computer...
speaker: Steve Jobs
content: The most compelling reason for most people to buy a computer for the home will be to link it into a nationwide communications network. We're just in the beginning stages of what will be a truly remarkable breakthrough for most people--as remarkable as the telephone.
